# Weak observer registration needs the matching interface and lifetime

A service observer registered with a weak reference must declare QueryInterface with the observer and weak-reference interfaces. Account color handling also removes its service observers on unload. DOM listeners and service observers have different ownership; inspect the source before adding or removing cleanup. D211687 explicitly caught the missing QueryInterface.

Scope: account settings observers.

Paths:

- `mailnews/base/prefs/content/AccountManager.js`
